name: @dostal/framework
description: Shadcn-style component framework for drone property intelligence — plug-and-play React components (MapLibre layer viewer, 3D/point-cloud viewer, geo-anchored model overlay, video walkthrough player, Minecraft terrain voxelizer + exporter), each with a live demo and full docs. Own the viewer, buy only compute.
_model3d_component_note: @react-three/fiber/@react-three/drei were bumped from the originally-scaffolded ^8.17.0/^9.114.0 to ^9.7.0/^10.7.8 (model3d-component story): v8 pairs with React 18 only — its bundled react-reconciler host config reads pre-React-19 internals (crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading ReactCurrentOwner)' the instant <Canvas> mounts) and can't be bridged by a newer react-reconciler either (0.31+ needs a resolveUpdatePriority host-config hook v8's compiled renderer never implements — verified empirically, no react-reconciler version satisfies both React 19's internals AND v8's host config). v9 is pmndrs' from-scratch React-19 rewrite (own bundled reconciler, no external react-reconciler dep) and is what actually renders + accepts OrbitControls input under react ^19.0.0 — confirmed via live Playwright verification. three ^0.169.0 unchanged (still satisfies both packages' peer range).
_pipeline_not_bundled: WebODM (docker), GDAL (gdal2tiles/gdaldem/gdal_contour), rio-cogeo, rio-pmtiles, rio-rgbify, PDAL (LAZ->COPC), tippecanoe, gltf-transform/obj2gltf — live in /pipeline as scripts+docker, never in the Vercel bundle.
